headline: BancFirst Reports Third-Quarter Net Income of $67.3 Million
summary: Oklahoma-based BancFirst Corporation announced net income of $67.3 million, or $1.97 per diluted share, for the third quarter.
why: BancFirst is an Oklahoma banking institution whose quarterly earnings reflect regional business activity and lending margins.

impacts.name: BancFirst Corporation
impacts.why: Quarterly net income updates regional investors on the bank's operational profitability.
